subject: Starter bundle and accelerator credit consolidation request
messages:
From: Kate Lin <kate@seedignite.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: SeedIgnite Ops <ops@seedignite.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter bundle + accelerator credit request

Hi Soojin,

Quick one — SeedIgnite is coming up to Demo Day and several of the cohort teams want to buy Redwood's Starter Onboarding bundle (includes 2 weeks of dedicated ramp support + 50k free tokens) but they also have accelerator promo credits from our joint program. Our operations team would like those promos to be applied against the onboarding bundle so the founders can get the integration help without paying out of pocket.

Attached is our current MOU and a short usage snapshot for the cohort (usage_report_q2.csv). The ask: can Redwood apply accelerator promo credits to offset the onboarding fee for up to three startups in this cohort? If not full coverage, what's the maximum portion you can approve?

Timing: Demo Day is 08/20 — if we can get approvals and a signed addendum by 08/12 the teams will be able to onboard before the event.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this helps close the founders and drives long-term committed usage.

Thanks,
Kate Lin
Partnerships Lead, SeedIgnite
kate@seedignite.com

Attachments:
- SeedIgnite_MOU.pdf
- usage_report_q2.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@seedignite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starter bundle + accelerator credit request

Hi Kate — thanks for the note and for the collateral. I reviewed the MOU and the usage snapshot. Short answer: we can usually only apply promo credits to usage (consumption) rather than one-off professional services invoices, but we do have a limited carve‑out path for strategic accelerator partners.

Proposed path:
- We can allow accelerator promo credits to be used to offset up to 50% of the Starter Onboarding fee for up to three cohort companies, as a one-time, non-recurring concession.
- Condition: teams must sign a short addendum (DocuSign) acknowledging that credits applied to onboarding are a one-time waiver and that future usage/Committed Dedicated contracts are billed normally.
- We need a usage trigger (the CSV helps) and a cost calc from Finance; I’ve looped in Ben (sales lead) and Laura (finance) to confirm feasibility.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the three company names and main contact emails so we can route addenda individually.
2) Confirm acceptance of the 50% cap and target signature date of 08/12.

Ben/Laura — can you take a quick look? If finance is comfortable with the 50% concession and we record it as a one-time billing addendum, I’ll send the DocuSign link to Kate today. Attached: onboarding_cost_calc.xlsx (draft).

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

--- Original message attached below for internal context ---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Starter bundle + accelerator credit request — recommend one-time concession

Laura,

Forwarding SeedIgnite request (below). Quick summary and recommendation:
- SeedIgnite asks that accelerator promo credits be applied toward the Starter Onboarding fee for up to three founders (Demo Day shipment).
- Proposed concession: allow credits to cover 60% of onboarding fee for up to three accounts (one-time), but require addendum and acceptance of standard billing terms afterward. I recommend 60% to improve conversion — SeedIgnite cohorts convert at ~35% to paid within 60 days and this could materially lift committed usage.

Numbers attached: onboarding_cost_calc.xlsx (breaks down service hours, expected token consumption, and net revenue impact). If we do 60% we estimate a short-term revenue giveback of ~$4.8k across the three accounts but expect follow-on consumption that offsets this within Q3.

Ask: can Finance record a non-standard discount (one-time) on these three invoices and confirm no downstream accounting issues? If Legal/Revenue ops needs wording, happy to have them approve the DocuSign text.

If you’re ok I’ll tell Soojin to send the addendum link to Kate.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- onboarding_cost_calc.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@seedignite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starter bundle + accelerator credit request

Hi Kate — good news: Finance approved a one-time concession with conditions. Final terms below:

What we will do
- Apply SeedIgnite accelerator promo credits to cover up to $5,000 (roughly 60% of the Starter Onboarding fee) for each of the three named cohort companies. This is a one-time application that reduces the onboarding invoice.

Conditions
- Each team must sign the attached addendum (DocuSign) that: 1) acknowledges the one-time credit application, 2) confirms any future usage will be billed normally, and 3) agrees to provide access to a short post-onboarding usage report 30 days after go-live.
- DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/addendum/SIG-928 (please sign by 2026-08-12 to meet Demo Day timeline).

Please reply with the three company names and contact emails today and I’ll send the three individualized DocuSign invites. Once signed we’ll schedule onboarding slots (we have limited ramp engineers the week of 08/17).

Thanks — looking forward to getting these teams live.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- SeedIgnite_MOU.pdf
- onboarding_cost_calc.xlsx
